An '''individual''' was the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Astral Jester]]''. He hoped to lay a claim to a new [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] leading through the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]]. Eventually, he disappeared during a journey into that region.<ref name="Lessons">{{FFG|story=Lessons from the Past|book=Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|text=''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook}}</ref>
